name: one-update-drop
description: A template for testing your own market. The oracle starts at 1130 and three longs of different leverage buy from one maker there. At block 3 the oracle falls 15.6% in a single update, to 954, the size of the xyz:SKHX drop on Hyperliquid on 2026-07-27. Change the params to your market's margins and fee, change the accounts and the drop to the stress you worry about, and write in expected_outcomes what your design must guarantee.
headline: One oracle update cuts the price 15.6% (1130 -> 954): which of three longs survive at a 3% maintenance margin?

expected_outcomes.name: three-fills
expected_outcomes.description: The three market buys each fill against the maker.

expected_outcomes.name: mark-follows-the-drop
expected_outcomes.description: The mark ends at or below the dropped oracle price.

expected_outcomes.name: the-thinly-margined-long-is-closed
expected_outcomes.description: At least one long is liquidated by the drop.

expected_outcomes.name: the-well-margined-long-survives
expected_outcomes.description: Not every long is liquidated: the 3,000-deposit account keeps its position.
